methods.formula: Total addressable market (TAM) for similar roles = Number of companies in industry × Average number of roles per company × Average compensation per role
variables: Number of companies in industry (e.g., software publishing)

methods.formula: Market size = Sum over all known job postings of (Number of postings × Average compensation) for similar roles in relevant geography
variables: Number of job postings for similar roles (e.g., senior software engineer) in target region
Average compensation from postings or surveys

Compensation data may be self-reported and biased

methods.formula: Number of qualified candidates = Total labor force × Percentage with required skills × Percentage willing to relocate × Percentage accepting offer at given compensation
variables: Total labor force in relevant occupation (e.g., software developers)
Percentage with specific skills (e.g., AI, project management)

Offer acceptance rate at proposed compensation
search_queries: number of software developers in US 2024

variables: Total revenue of software industry
Average compensation-to-revenue ratio for tech companies
